rows.grounds: locative of compound mahā-jala; place of danger
locative indicating a body of water
first member of compound with madhye
goddess invoked as protector; subject carried from prior verses

items.question: In which aquatic and hostile settings does Sarasvatī grant protection to the devotee?
premises: Sarasvatī is invoked as the protecting goddess.
Protection is sought in great water and in a pond.
Protection is sought in the midst of enemies.
items.inference: Sarasvatī extends her protection to the devotee in perilous waters and among adversaries.
uncertainties: The verb of protection is implicit, carried over from the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: And in great water, in a pond, and in the midst of enemies, may Sarasvatī protect me.
